title: Alien Cover-up Conspiracy? Barrister Claims 'Congress Has Been Misled for 80 Years' Over UFO Tech
description: Barrister Jonathan Caplan KC claims Congress has been misled about UFOs for 80 years, promoting his book 'Not for Disclosure' which argues for transparency on alien visits and government secrecy.

title: Niece of couple who claimed to have encountered UFO in 1960s speaks at Exeter UFO Festival
description: In 1961, a New Hampshire couple was driving back to Portsmouth from Niagara Falls when they claimed they saw a UFO and were abducted. The couple's niece, Kathleen Marden, spoke at the Exeter UFO Festival on Saturday.
